reviewer_type: developer audit by Codex; not a clinician or independent human panel
method: One anonymous rerun per scenario, using the same observable criteria as the pre-fix assessment.

notes: The explicit no-question listening boundary was followed.
The action turn repaired the earlier questioning but asked the user to choose a category instead of supplying the requested small action.
The rupture response stopped assessment questions immediately.
The action response supplied one short, non-writing action after a rule-triggered rewrite.
The rupture response required a rewrite but then followed the listening boundary.
The action response expanded into several steps and ended with breathing and a question; one goal_misalignment issue remained after the bounded rewrite.

interpretation_limits: This is a one-sample engineering regression, not an efficacy comparison.
The pre-fix and post-fix aliases were independently randomized and must not be assumed to represent the same provider.
No independent or professional inter-rater agreement is available.
